meta.title: Laandet – rent, lend and give away locally in Steigen
meta.description: Laandet is a local meeting place in Steigen where you can rent out, lend, ask for and give away things.

footer.tagline: More use. Less buying. A little closer to each other.
footer.localStart: Made for the local community in Steigen.
footer.rankingText: Listings are shown newest first. Nobody can pay to appear higher up.
footer.pilotNote: Laandet is in a pilot phase. Example listings are marked «Example».

pages.howLead: A good deal starts with someone nearby.
pages.howRent1: Find something nearby with search and filters. You see the approximate area, price, deposit and how the item can be collected or delivered.
pages.howRent2: Soon you can send a request. The owner decides whether to accept it.
pages.howRent3: When you agree, Laandet creates a simple rental agreement that both accept. Payment happens directly between you.
pages.howRent4: At handover and return you record the condition with photos, so you both have the same documentation.
pages.howWanted1: Post a wanted listing, e.g. «Want to rent a trailer in Nordfold this weekend». Others can reply with their own listings.
pages.howGive1: Give away things you no longer need – free and for good. You choose who gets the item, and describe known faults honestly.
pages.howStatus: You can create an account, post all three types of listings and search. Requests, messages, rental agreements and condition reports open in the next step of the pilot.
pages.safetyLead: Safety is part of Laandet from the start. Here is what applies today – and what is planned.
pages.safetyNow1: Everyone who posts listings has confirmed their email address.
pages.safetyNow2: We only show approximate areas. Location and other information are removed from photos.
pages.safetyNow3: Every listing can be reported. Moderators give reasons for decisions, and you can appeal.
pages.safetyNow4: Prohibited and dangerous items are not allowed. Some categories need extra care.
pages.safetyNow5: Laandet does not handle money and never sends payment links.
pages.safetyPlanned1: Rental agreements, condition reports and a clear process when something goes wrong – coming in the next step of the pilot.
pages.safetyPlanned2: BankID verification and renting out items above 5 000 kr – later, when it is safe and legally clarified.
pages.safetyPlanned3: Laandet has no insurance for users. Check what your own insurance covers.
pages.aboutText1: Laandet is a local meeting place where things that already exist can be useful to more people. A trailer for moving, a carpet cleaner for the sofa or two kayaks when friends come to visit.
pages.aboutText2: We start in Steigen and build the service together with the people who use it. Laandet is an independent project in the G-PSI.ai portfolio.
pages.aboutText3: Laandet is a meeting place, not a rental company, a bank or an insurer. Agreements are made between users.
pages.contactLead: Questions, feedback or something to report?
pages.contactMissing: Contact details will be published before launch.
pages.transparencyLead: What it costs to run Laandet, and the voluntary support we have received.
pages.transparencyEmpty: We will publish figures once the first invoices and any contributions are recorded. We only show figures we have checked.

kind.review_restored: A review you wrote about "{title}" has been restored.

disputes.principles: Laandet helps you document the problem and agree, but does not decide who is right and never moves money. The case is private to the two of you.
disputes.notAvailable: A problem can be reported from the handover onwards.

categories.not_returned: The item has not been returned
categories.not_as_described: The item was not as described

disputes.safetyText: Stop using the equipment. In an emergency or if someone is hurt: call 113 (ambulance), 112 (police) or 110 (fire). Also tell the owner of the item. Laandet is not an emergency service.
disputes.summaryHint: Be factual and specific. The handover and return records are attached automatically.
disputes.deadlinesNote: The deadlines apply to case handling on Laandet. They do not limit your rights under Norwegian law.
disputes.statementHint: Plain text only. You can add photos, for example of receipts or damage.
disputes.noMessagesToAttach: There are no more messages to attach.
disputes.attachMessage: Choose a message from the conversation
disputes.attachMessageHint: If Laandet is asked for help, support can read the attached messages – only those.
disputes.proposalHint: Who does what, and when? The other person can accept, decline or make a counter-proposal.
disputes.noMoneyThroughLaandet: An agreed amount is paid directly between you. Laandet never receives or sends money.

status.support_review: Laandet support is looking at the case
status.referred_to_authority: Referred to an authority or the police

ok.opened: The case has been submitted. The other party has been told and has 7 days to answer.
ok.reference: The message is attached to the case.
ok.accepted: You accepted the proposal. The case is resolved by agreement.
ok.escalate: Laandet support has been asked to look at the case.

disputes.documentationBy: Laandet support has asked for more information by {date}.

closed.resolved_by_agreement: The case is resolved by agreement.
closed.closed_without_agreement: The case is closed without agreement.
closed.referred_to_insurer: The case is closed and goes on to an insurer.
closed.referred_to_authority: The case is closed and has been reported to an authority or the police.

disputes.externalOptions: You can still resolve the matter outside Laandet: a civil claim between private persons can be brought before the conciliation board (forliksrådet) where the other party lives, and your own home or liability insurance may cover some of it. If you believe a crime may have been committed, you can contact the police (politiet.no or 02800). Laandet has no insurance for users.
disputes.waitingForAnswer: Waiting for the other party's answer.
disputes.recommendationNotBinding: The recommendation is not binding. If you both accept it, the case is resolved by agreement.
disputes.guidance: Be factual and specific. Describe what happened, add photos, and propose a solution you think is fair.
disputes.supportFollowing: Laandet support is following the case. The aim is a first answer within 5 working days during the pilot, but this is not a guarantee.
disputes.escalateNote: Support will read the case, the handover and return records and the attached messages. Both of you are told.
disputes.escalateLater: You can ask Laandet for help once the other party has answered, or when the deadline to answer has passed.
disputes.messageUnavailable: The message is no longer available.
disputes.reopened: The case was reopened by Laandet support

staff.queueLead: Only cases where a party asked for help. The case text is shown only once you take the case, with a reason – and every view is logged.
staff.noGrant: You have no access to the case content. Take the case with a reason to get access for 30 days. Everything you view is logged.
staff.reopenReason: What new information has come in?
staff.grantUntil: You have access to the case until {date}. Every view is logged.
staff.recommendHint: Keep what is documented apart from what the parties disagree about. Lack of evidence is not proof of fault.
staff.requestDocsText: What do you need? The parties have 7 days.
staff.closeHint: When closing without agreement, the parties see neutral information about the conciliation board, the police and insurance.
staff.limits: Support cannot change evidence, accept on behalf of a party, move money or publish anything about the case. Account measures are separate decisions with reasons and a right to appeal.

ok.taken: You have taken the case. Access lasts 30 days.
ok.documentation: The parties have been asked for more documentation.
ok.recommended: The recommendation has been sent to the parties.

adminPanel.reasonHint: 10–500 characters. Say why the change is made.
adminPanel.saved: The change is saved and logged.
adminPanel.allowPaidRental: Paid rental is allowed (off: free lending only, see D-028)
adminPanel.active: Active (can be chosen in new listings)
adminPanel.categoriesLeadAdmin: Change names, policy, safety notice and allowed listing types. The address (slug) never changes.
adminPanel.categoriesLeadModerator: As a moderator you can change a category's policy. Other changes are made by an administrator.
adminPanel.publishedListings: {count, plural, one {# published listing} other {# published listings}}
adminPanel.prohibitedHasListings: {count, plural, one {# published listing} other {# published listings}} in this category are not hidden automatically. Review them through the report queue or the listing pages.
adminPanel.localitiesLead: The places people can choose in listings. The address (slug) is used in shared links and never changes.
adminPanel.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. «nordfold». Cannot be changed later.
adminPanel.localityActive: Active (can be chosen in new listings)
adminPanel.flagsLead: Switch features on and off. Each change needs a reason and is logged.
adminPanel.flagHighValueWarning: Rentals above 5 000 kr are blocked in the database until BankID and the deposit procedure exist. This switch does not change that.
adminPanel.legalLead: Every loaded version per document and language. Texts are loaded with «npm run legal:load» and cannot be changed here.
adminPanel.legalNotReviewed: No text can be marked as legally reviewed here. Drafts stay drafts until a lawyer has reviewed them and new versions are loaded.
adminPanel.securityLead: The latest {limit} events in the audit log. Read-only. IP addresses exist only as keyed hashes.
adminPanel.metricsLead: Counts by status, the email queue and the background jobs. Numbers only, no personal data.
adminPanel.jobsOk: All jobs have run as expected.
adminPanel.jobsAttention: {count, plural, one {# job needs} other {# jobs need}} attention.
adminPanel.transparencyLead: Actual monthly figures from invoices and payout statements. They are shown on the «Transparency» page. No estimates here.
adminPanel.addMonthHint: The same month again corrects the one already recorded.
adminPanel.amountHint: Amounts in kroner, e.g. «1 500» or «1500,50». The parts cannot add up to more than the total. Leave support empty if there is no fundraising campaign.
adminPanel.sourceNoteHint: Invoice numbers and payout references. Never shown on the public page.

transparency.actualLead: Figures from invoices and payout statements, recorded by the owner. Amounts in kroner incl. VAT.
transparency.estimatesLead: These are estimates from the cost model, not actual costs. Amounts per month, including 25 % VAT:
transparency.estimatesVariantB: If only the larger server can be ordered, it is about {low}–{high} a month for up to 2 000 users.
transparency.estimatesNote: The prices are not yet confirmed with the providers. Legal review and the owner's time come on top and are not estimated.

reviews.title: Review
reviews.deadline: You can write the review until {date}.
reviews.scaleHint: 1 is the worst and 5 the best.
reviews.commentHint: At most 1 000 characters. Be fair and honest. Do not write other people's names, addresses or phone numbers.
reviews.blindNote: The review cannot be changed afterwards. Neither of you sees the other's review until both have written, or until the deadline has passed.

ok.sealed: Thank you! Your review has been submitted. It is published when both have written, or when the deadline has passed.
ok.published: Thank you! Both of you have written, and the reviews are published.

reviews.sealedNote: Your review has been submitted but is not published yet.
reviews.sealedUntil: It is published by {date} at the latest, or when the other party has written theirs. If a case about the rental is open, publication waits until the case is closed.
reviews.removedNote: Your review was removed by Laandet. You have been given the reasons and can appeal.
reviews.windowClosed: The deadline for writing a review has passed.
reviews.notYet: You can write a review when the rental is completed.

privacyExport.heading: My data
privacyExport.lead: Download everything Laandet holds about you: profile, listings, your own messages, rentals, agreements, condition reports, reviews, reports and cases.
privacyExport.note: The file contains personal data. Keep it safe. You can download it five times a day.
privacyExport.limit: You have downloaded your data five times in the last day. Please try again later.
